title: thelypteris microbasis
intro: Thelypteris microbasis, commonly known as the Microbasis Maiden's Hair Fern, is a species of fern belonging to the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The health benefits of Thelypteris microbasis include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which have been reported to have therapeutic actions such as reducing pain and inflammation, as well as promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
